entries.title: Fixed Gathered Bag and Star Mouth Nozzle
entries.description: One newly authored complete static pastry-piping-bag appearance lying on its flattened lower side. One continuous opaque soft-looking body widens from a narrow nozzle neck into a broad slightly asymmetric belly, then gathers through a twisted waist into a whole flattened flared tail. A thick independent coupling joins one complete hollow metal-looking nozzle with a genuinely six-lobed blunt mouth and full inner wall. No rear cap or separate loose tips are added. The main bag is opaque and closed, with no claimed internal contents; the nozzle cavity terminates against that body. Unlike the original compressed metal paint tubes, this has no crimp seam, screw neck or removable screw cap, and no old tube or squeeze-bulb geometry is reused. Three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. Static baking-workshop visual only: no icing, food contact, hygiene, squeezing, pressure, extrusion, cloth simulation, recipe, operating instructions, manufacture or safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
